About

Highly Recommended

Based on 940 glowing reviews from clients

Careful, polished treatments are at the heart of Le Senes Spa, where clients appreciate the staff’s precision and attentive approach. The classic Moroccan bath is especially praised for thorough care, while manicures and pedicures and eyebrow cleaning reflect the same focus on detail. A calm setting and welcoming service make appointments feel relaxing and leave clients pleased with their results.
